record.title: Project #2 backlog execution
record.body: Backlog execution started from live Project #2 project.items snapshot (404 items; 402 observed Todo text matches in the receipt search, treated as a match count rather than a fabricated distinct-item count). Terminal stale issues closed after live repository revalidation: dspygen#13 completed; dspygen#6 superseded/not_planned; kanban#2 completed; kanban#4 completed; kanban#7 completed; kanban#14 completed. Active repair workstreams: dspygen PR#48 secret-hygiene exact head 1bab047866ef7052e247e7ec8e727be932939fa4 after two verification-created repairs; kanban PR#17 Docker secrets head 7d683fd20743f0c9bb38b6f8168470d57c79cd08; kanban PR#18 CPU alert threshold head fe198a8554916781c45a750edc1c387fca7763a8; kanban PR#19 unused-dependency CI head 5735e58b9f40954e8d0e025de03cc0d14a7db94a. Kanban hosted PR CI currently fails before executing steps across these independent heads, classified BUILD_BROKEN[HOSTED_WORKFLOW_PREEXEC]; build/push and deploy jobs were skipped. kanban#13 repository evidence shows rollback configuration exists, but issue-state mutation was refused by the tool safety gate and remains open. No external credential rotation, package publication, deployment, or live infrastructure actuation was performed.
